Salamander Grand Piano v3
Original recordings: Alexander Holm
Instrument: Yamaha C5
License: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
https://github.com/sfzinstruments/SalamanderGrandPiano

MP3 distribution: https://github.com/tambien/Piano/tree/master/audio
This application uses the original MP3 files for velocity layers 2, 5, 8,
11 and 15 at 30 sampled pitches, A0 through C8. Original files are unchanged.
Playback resamples to 24 kHz stereo in memory and applies gain, release and
room reverberation. Attribution does not imply the author's endorsement.
